definitions.gloss: life-size; life-sized; in the same dimensions as a real human body
definitions.explanation: Describes an object — most often a statue, doll, poster, or mannequin — that is made in the exact proportions and size of a real human. Literally 'in the size of one's (whole) body'.
Figurative use: describes a portrayal or self-image that presents a person honestly, without exaggeration or idealization. Common in talking about fiction, memoirs, and public personas.

examples.japanese: {等身大|とうしんだい}の⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧。
⟦{店内|てんない}→店内：03124_tennai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{等身大|とうしんだい}の⟦{銅像|どうぞう}→銅像：14471_douzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A life-size bronze statue stands inside the shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{等身大|とうしんだい}の⟦パネル→パネル：08840_paneru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{記念|きねん}{写真|しゃしん}→記念写真：23222_kinenshashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧にぎわって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The area in front of the station was crowded with tourists taking commemorative photos with the life-size panel set up there.

examples.japanese: {等身大|とうしんだい}の⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{等身大|とうしんだい}の⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}った→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: She spoke about herself as she really is.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{等身大|とうしんだい}の⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ありのまま→ありのまま：05735_arinomama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: This novel is a work in which the author honestly portrays himself as he was in his youth, without any embellishment.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{等身|とうしん}→等身：24314_toushin⟧ ('proportional to one's body') and {大|だい} ('size'), plus the attributive particle ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧. Literally 'of a size equal to one's body', hence 'life-size'.

USAGE:
- Normally used attributively with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {等身大|とうしんだい}の⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧ ('life-size doll'). It is not naturally used as a predicate (✗ ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{等身大|とうしんだい}→等身大：16861_toushindai⟧だ is dispreferred; say ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧だ instead).
- Sense 2 is a productive metaphor meaning 'life-size' in the sense of 'undistorted by idealization'. Frequent in book reviews, interviews, and essays.
- ⟦{等身|とうしん}→等身：24314_toushin⟧ alone is rarely used in modern Japanese outside this fixed form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {等身大|とうしんだい}の⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧: life-size doll
- {等身大|とうしんだい}の⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧: life-size statue
- {等身大|とうしんだい}の⟦パネル→パネル：08840_paneru⟧: life-size cardboard cutout / standee
- {等身大|とうしんだい}の⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧: one's true self, unembellished self
- {等身大|とうしんだい}の⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to portray (someone) as they really are
- {等身大|とうしんだい}の⟦ヒーロー→ヒーロー：11262_hiiroo⟧: a hero the audience can relate to

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実物大|じつぶつだい}→実物大：16710_jitsubutsudai⟧: life-size; actual size — used for any object (cars, animals, buildings), not limited to the human body.
- ⟦{原寸大|げんすんだい}→原寸大：20738_gensundai⟧: full-scale; original-size — emphasizes 'same dimensions as the original' and is common in printing, design, and architectural drawings.
- ⟦ありのまま→ありのまま：05735_arinomama⟧: as it is; unembellished — close in spirit to sense 2, but an adverb/noun rather than a modifier.
